description: Replaces an existing Google Calendar event using its event ID and required start time. Omitted fields can be cleared, but existing conference data is preserved by default when available; supply the desired event details for the replacement.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: REQUIRED. The unique identifier of the event to update. This parameter is MANDATORY - events cannot be updated by title, date, or other criteria. You MUST first retrieve the event_id by using GOOGLECALENDAR_FIND_EVENT or GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST to search for the event, then use the returned 'id' field here.
event_id.human_parameter_description: REQUIRED. The unique ID of the event you want to update. You MUST obtain this ID first by searching/listing events (use GOOGLECALENDAR_FIND_EVENT or GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST), then copy the 'id' field from the event you want to update.

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location of the event as free-form text.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name from the timezone database (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Jerusalem', 'UTC'). Required if datetime is naive. For recurring events, start and end must include a timeZone. If not provided, UTC is used. If datetime includes timezone info (Z or offset), this field is optional and defaults to UTC. IMPORTANT: Must be a valid IANA timezone identifier. Values like 'EST', 'PST', 'ISRAEL TIME', or other abbreviations are NOT valid IANA timezone names.

attendees.title: Attendees
attendees.description: List of attendees. Each attendee can be either: (1) A string email address (e.g., 'user@example.com'), or (2) An object with 'email' (required), 'optional' (boolean, default false), 'displayName' (string), 'comment' (string), 'additionalGuests' (integer), and 'resource' (boolean). To mark an attendee as optional (not required), use object format: {'email': 'user@example.com', 'optional': true}. IMPORTANT: Only valid email addresses are accepted. Plain names cannot be used.

eventType.title: Event Type
eventType.description: Type of the event, immutable post-creation. 'workingLocation' (REQUIRES Google Workspace Enterprise). Note: 'fromGmail' events cannot be created via API.

recurrence.title: Recurrence
recurrence.description: List of RRULE, EXRULE, RDATE, EXDATE lines for recurring events. Supported frequencies: DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY. For recurring events, start.timeZone and end.timeZone must be present. UNTIL values follow RFC 5545: date-only (YYYYMMDD) for all-day events, or UTC datetime with Z suffix (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ) for timed events. UNTIL values with time but missing Z suffix are auto-corrected. Provide an empty list to remove recurrence so the event becomes non-recurring.

calendar_id.title: Calendar Id
calendar_id.description: Identifier of the Google Calendar where the event resides. The value 'primary' targets the user's primary calendar.
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: The calendar where the event lives. Use 'primary' for your main calendar, or enter an email address or calendar ID to target a different calendar.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the event. Can contain HTML. Optional. Must be omitted for 'birthday' event type.

end_datetime.title: End Datetime
end_datetime.description: Event end time in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. When provided, this parameter takes precedence over event_duration_hour and event_duration_minutes. If not provided, the end time is calculated using start_datetime + duration. Must be after start_datetime. Explicit timezone information (Z or an offset) is preserved; offset-less values are interpreted in `timezone`, or UTC when it is omitted.

send_updates.title: SendUpdates
send_updates.description: Options for who should receive notifications about event changes.

start_datetime.title: Start Datetime
start_datetime.description: REQUIRED. Event start time in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. IMPORTANT: Natural language expressions like 'tomorrow', 'next Monday', '2pm tomorrow' are NOT supported and will be rejected. You must provide the exact date and time in ISO format. Explicit timezone information (Z or an offset) is preserved; offset-less values are interpreted in `timezone`, or UTC when it is omitted. Examples: '2025-01-16T13:00:00', '2025-01-16T13:00:00Z', '2025-01-16T13:00:00-05:00'.

guestsCanModify.title: Guests Can Modify
guestsCanModify.description: If True, guests can modify the event.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of birthday event: 'birthday', 'anniversary', or 'other'. Defaults to 'birthday'.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Contact ID in format 'people/c12345' from Google People API. REQUIRED when type is 'anniversary' or 'other'. MUST BE OMITTED when type is 'birthday' (the API forbids contact field for type='birthday').

customTypeName.title: Custom Type Name
customTypeName.description: Custom type name when type is 'other'. Requires valid contact field.

create_meeting_room.title: Create Meeting Room
create_meeting_room.description: Defaults to True. When True, for CREATE operations creates a Google Meet link; for UPDATE operations preserves existing conference data if present, or adds a new Meet link if none exists. Google Workspace accounts will successfully receive a Meet link. Personal Gmail accounts and other unsupported accounts will gracefully fallback to creating an event without a Meet link when conference creation fails. Set to False to skip Meet link operations (won't create new or modify existing conference data). The fallback ensures event creation succeeds even when conference features are unavailable due to account limitations.

event_duration_hour.title: Event Duration Hour
event_duration_hour.description: Number of hours for the event duration. Supports multi-day events (e.g., 240 hours = 10 days). For durations under 1 hour, use event_duration_minutes instead. Ignored if end_datetime is provided.

extended_properties.title: Extended Properties
extended_properties.description: Extended properties of the event for storing custom metadata. Contains 'private' (visible only on this calendar) and/or 'shared' (visible to all attendees) dictionaries mapping string keys to string values. Example: {'private': {'key1': 'value1'}, 'shared': {'key2': 'value2'}}

focusTimeProperties.title: FocusTimeProperties

chatStatus.title: ChatStatus
chatStatus.description: Chat status during focus time: 'active' or 'doNotDisturb'.

declineMessage.title: Decline Message
declineMessage.description: Message to include in declined meeting invitations. Only used when autoDeclineMode is set.

autoDeclineMode.title: AutoDeclineMode
autoDeclineMode.description: Auto decline mode: 'declineNone' (no invitations declined), 'declineAllConflictingInvitations' (all conflicting invitations declined), or 'declineOnlyNewConflictingInvitations' (only new conflicting invitations declined).

focusTimeProperties.description: Properties for focusTime events. REQUIRES Google Workspace Enterprise account with Focus Time feature enabled.

guestsCanInviteOthers.title: Guests Can Invite Others
guestsCanInviteOthers.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can invite others to the event.

declineMessage.title: Decline Message
declineMessage.description: Message to include in declined meeting invitations. Only used when autoDeclineMode is set.

autoDeclineMode.title: AutoDeclineMode
autoDeclineMode.description: Auto decline mode: 'declineNone' (no invitations declined), 'declineAllConflictingInvitations' (all conflicting invitations declined), or 'declineOnlyNewConflictingInvitations' (only new conflicting invitations declined). RECURRING EVENT RESTRICTION: For recurring out-of-office events, ONLY 'declineOnlyNewConflictingInvitations' is allowed. Cannot use 'declineAllConflictingInvitations' for recurring OOO (Google Calendar prevents retroactively declining existing meetings). REQUIRES Google Workspace (paid business subscription, e.g., Business Starter at $6/user/month). Personal Gmail accounts cannot use this feature.

event_duration_minutes.title: Event Duration Minutes
event_duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes (0-59 ONLY). NEVER use 60+ minutes - use event_duration_hour=1 instead. Maximum value is 59. Combined duration (hours + minutes) must be greater than 0. Ignored if end_datetime is provided.

guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.title: Guests Can See Other Guests
guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can see who the event's attendees are.

workingLocationProperties.title: WorkingLocationProperties

homeOffice.title: WorkingLocationHomeOffice
homeOffice.description:
Empty object marker for home office working location.

This is used to indicate the user is working from home.
Google Calendar API accepts an empty object for this field.

customLocation.title: WorkingLocationCustom

label.title: Label
label.description: Label for a custom working location (e.g., 'Client site').

customLocation.description: Custom working location with a display label.

label.title: Label
label.description: Office name displayed in Calendar clients (e.g., building name).

buildingId.title: Building Id
buildingId.description: Optional building identifier from org Resources.

workingLocationProperties.description:
Properties for workingLocation events. REQUIRES Google Workspace Enterprise.

Constraints discovered from testing:
- Must set transparency='transparent' and visibility='public'
- Description must be omitted
- Depending on 'type', include one of 'homeOffice', 'officeLocation', or 'customLocation'

self.title: Self
self.description: Is this the authenticated user's calendar.

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: Is the attendee a resource (e.g., a room).

additionalGuests.title: Additional Guests
additionalGuests.description: Number of additional guests brought by the attendee.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Override reminders if useDefault is false.

useDefault.title: Use Default
useDefault.description: Whether the default reminders of the calendar are used.

self.title: Self
self.description: Whether this person corresponds to the calendar on which this copy of the event appears.

timeZone.title: Time Zone
timeZone.description: Time zone for the time specified.

id.title: Id
id.description: Opaque identifier of the event. Unique within a calendar.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: Whether this event is locked and cannot be modified by attendees

source.title: Source
source.description: Source from which the event was created

colorId.title: Color Id
colorId.description: ID of the color used to display this event.

iCalUID.title: I Cal Uid
iCalUID.description: Globally unique identifier as defined in RFC5545.

htmlLink.title: Html Link
htmlLink.description: Absolute link to the Google Calendar Web UI for this event.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: Sequence number as defined in RFC5545. Incremented on changes.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Information about the event's reminders for the authenticated user

recurrence.title: Recurrence
recurrence.description: List of RRULE/EXRULE/RDATE/EXDATE lines for a recurring event

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the event. May contain HTML.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view this event in Google Calendar web UI. Auto-populated from htmlLink.

hangoutLink.title: Hangout Link
hangoutLink.description: Link to the Google Meet (deprecated in favor of conferenceData)

privateCopy.title: Private Copy
privateCopy.description: Whether this is a private copy of the event

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Event transparency: 'opaque' blocks time; 'transparent' does not.

conferenceData.title: Conference Data
conferenceData.description: Information about conference solutions attached to the event

guestsCanModify.title: Guests Can Modify
guestsCanModify.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can modify the event

anyoneCanAddSelf.title: Anyone Can Add Self
anyoneCanAddSelf.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can invite themselves

attendeesOmitted.title: Attendees Omitted
attendeesOmitted.description: Whether attendees were omitted from the API response.

recurringEventId.title: Recurring Event Id
recurringEventId.description: ID of the recurring event to which this instance belongs

originalStartTime.title: Original Start Time
originalStartTime.description: For instances of recurring events, the time at which this recurrence instance starts.

endTimeUnspecified.title: End Time Unspecified
endTimeUnspecified.description: Whether the end time is unspecified

extendedProperties.title: Extended Properties
extendedProperties.description: Extended properties for private and shared use

focusTimeProperties.title: Focus Time Properties
focusTimeProperties.description: Properties for a focus time event

guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.title: Guests Can See Other Guests
guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.description: Whether attendees can see the guest list

workingLocationProperties.title: Working Location Properties
workingLocationProperties.description: Properties for a working location event

chatStatus.title: Chat Status
chatStatus.description: Chat status during focus time: 'available' or 'doNotDisturb'.

response_data.title: Response Data
response_data.description: The updated Google Calendar event resource returned after a successful update.

entryPointType.title: Entry Point Type
entryPointType.description: Type: video, phone, sip, or more

error.title: Error

successful.title: Successful
